Trimming the bottom section off at the clearly designated line helps a smaller adult face wear the mask frame more comfortably.

This feels more like plastic than silicone. It irritated my chin quite a bit. With a bit of warmth, the mask suctioned to my face. So uncomfortable. I shared these with coworkers and not one person thought it was a great product. It definitely helps you breathe better but not worth all the down sides.

Just another piece of plastic you have continually adjust.  Did not make it more comfortable or less hot or my glasses less steamy.  I could have tried to return them but to be safe I just threw them away.
These really work at giving you breathing room under cloth masks..I attach mine with a Velcro dot to keep it from sliding..

I kept trying different brackets.  These are just right. they settle high enough on my nose to be stable, and not so high that they aim air right up my glasses provided I make sure that the mask fits snugly. They hit fare nigh down my chin to be stable while talking, soft enough that the way they hit my face is not uncomfortable, wide enough to hit my cheek bones, and raise the mask enough for both breathing and talking. Many were too small, hitting from the tip of my nose to just under my botto

I hate having anything over my nose, including masks. With a mask directly on your nose and mouth it restricts the recycled air that I am already breathing. These inserts create just enough space between your nose and mouth from the mask to make it a little better to breath and speak. I was worried about the insert slipping but surprisingly it stays put, very little slippage. Just a little needle and thread to the inside of your mask and it stays put permanently. I want to give this product a 4.

I’m also a bit claustrophobic but these seem to help there too. I do think this company should hire me though. Your face gets really sweaty and uncomfortable

I love my mask bracket, especially since I don’t have much of a nose and it keeps the mask from sucking into my mouth every time I try to talk or breathe.  To keep it from falling out when I remove my mask, I just add a stitch from the mask to the bracket and I’m good to go.  It’s easy to keep clean and also feels cooler since the material is kep away from my face.  It also helps my glasses from fogging up.

reviews.t: A good deal for 10 masks pads
reviews.x: I ended up sewing a couple of stitches into my masks to keep the pads in place as suggested by another reviewer.  What I did not anticipate was how much I perspire and the plastic would stick to my face.  Very uncomfortable.  I am not currently using them.  I rated them 4 stars because I think for most people they will work fine.

It is not good. The breath made the mask became wet and built up water droplets.not good for cold climate because of the water building up. It is bad for your lunge to breath on a moisture that builds up on the mask. If I knew, I would not have bought them.  What a waste of money. Not that good produts.
These barely cover your face and if you dare to speak it will scratch, cut and move around. Save your money. Buy from elsewhere and check the size
This is way too small for an adult.  Not comfortable at all.  Even my teens think it is too small and awkward.  Do not recommend.
Way small. No way to fit it in the mask. Just falls out. Rubs on nose and face. Awful. Good idea, terrible implementation.

reviews.t: Comfort is key. Fits me perfectly!
reviews.x: I liked the weight and design. I have worn this inside five different mask patterns I sewed together for different family members. It worked in all five. I do need a larger size for one member so I am going to look and see if they have a larger size. These make great stocking stuffers. Sent some to my kids.

Not tall enough to work!  If it’s on my nose, the bottom hits me mid-chin.  The top part then slides up, and pushes my mask up into my eyes.  The point was to keep the mask from rubbing on my face, but this would rub worse on my chin.  Returning.

I was afraid the plastic would chafe my face but these are a soft and pliable material that works really well. It was a nice change not to be sucking that mask in and everyone was able to understand me when I spoke. I love this thing.

reviews.t: More annoying to wear than not
reviews.x: Very uncomfortable. After wearing for a walk to the park, I couldn’t stop adjusting and it irritated my face. I felt so much better when I just took it off.
This product is very small - too short to properly fit most women's faces because it doesn't go under the chin.  It's okay for children.

reviews.t: Not for adult. Plastic not silicone. Disappointed.
reviews.x: This is a plastic brace not silicone. And it is child size not adult. No adult whom tried this on did it fit.
It just made built up moisture and didn’t stay put. But it may work better for someone else.
They should tell you they’re child size. I couldn’t even give them away

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bracket comfortable and helpful for breathing, keeping the mask off their mouth and nose.
Several reviewers complain the material feels like hard plastic rather than silicone, and some report it breaking easily or being rough and inflexible.
Some reviewers say the product is too small for a regular adult face and can scratch or move around when speaking.
A few reviewers report discomfort from sweating and the plastic sticking to their face.
Some reviewers mention moisture or water droplets building up on the mask.
